final_decisions: Reference local sandbox provider is rootless Podman. Host networking and privileged containers are prohibited.
High-assurance RuntimeProvider is Firecracker-capable and remains adapter-isolated; it does not change domain contracts.
Lab network egress is deny-by-default. Explicit allowlists are per lab and audited. Arbitrary Internet targeting is outside the OSS product boundary.
Agent enrollment uses one-time tokens and short-lived mTLS identity from an AgentIdentityProvider; OpenBao PKI is the reference production provider.
Remote agent/content updates use TUF-style update metadata; content packs are immutable, hash-addressed, schema-versioned bundles.
Scenario actions are declarative safe-simulation capabilities. No arbitrary shell/payload primitive is part of the public v1 ABI.
PostgreSQL owns lab/scenario/run state. Runtime state is reconciled, never treated as authority.

data_ownership.Valkey: queues, short-lived locks and cache only
data_ownership.ObjectStore: immutable run artifacts and exported reports
